name: Deathstalkers in Shadowfang
summary: High Executor Hadrec dispatches Horde adventurers into Shadowfang Keep to locate two missing reconnaissance agents, Deathstalker Adamant and Deathstalker Vincent. The Forsaken military relies on their gathered intelligence to coordinate an assault against Archmage Arugal and his worgen packs. Breaching the fortress reveals the grim reality of espionage behind enemy lines.

sections.title: Into the Worgen Den
sections.body: Silverpine Forest remains contested ground, with Archmage Arugal's feral worgen holding the towering redoubt of Shadowfang Keep. Seeking to break this siege on their southern borders, the Forsaken command stationed at the Sepulcher organized an intelligence operation. High Executor Hadrec sent two seasoned Deathstalkers—Adamant and Vincent—to infiltrate the fortress and chart its defenses. When days passed without word, Hadrec grew desperate for their field reports, tasking capable Horde champions with entering the stronghold to recover the agents and salvage the mission.

sections.title: A Bitter Discovery
sections.body: Upon fighting their way through the lower ramparts, adventurers discover the heavy price of the infiltration. While Deathstalker Adamant survives in captivity and assists in unbarring the courtyard gates, Vincent met a brutal end. His broken corpse lies motionless within the keep, his personal intelligence lost to the dark halls. Only a small trinket remains clenched in his cold fingers, serving as quiet testament to a spy who gave his unlife for the Dark Lady's conquest.

faq.q: Why were Deathstalkers sent to Shadowfang Keep?
faq.answer: High Executor Hadrec ordered the infiltration to gather vital tactical intelligence on Archmage Arugal's forces and fortifications before committing Forsaken troops to a full-scale assault on Shadowfang Keep.

faq.q: Who are Deathstalkers Adamant and Vincent?
faq.answer: They are elite Forsaken operatives belonging to the Deathstalkers, the espionage and assassination branch of the Undercity. Sent ahead as advance scouts, they were tasked with mapping Shadowfang Keep and observing the worgen defenses.
Vincent has not reported back from Shadowfang Keep. Hadrec needs someone to enter the fortress and discover what happened to him.

faq.q: What role does Deathstalker Adamant play inside the keep?
faq.answer: Adamant is one of the missing Deathstalkers sent to gather intelligence inside Shadowfang Keep. His situation is learned during the search.

aliases: where to get deathstalkers in shadowfang
faq.answer: The mission is given by High Executor Hadrec, the Forsaken military commander stationed at the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest.

faq.q: Why does the Forsaken leadership want Shadowfang Keep cleared?
faq.answer: Archmage Arugal unleashes violent worgen packs across Silverpine Forest from his perch in Shadowfang Keep, constantly threatening Forsaken holdings, supply lines, and the overall security of Lordaeron.

angles.text: For the Forsaken, reclaiming Silverpine from Arugal's beasts is essential to securing Lordaeron. The missing scouts show the danger of that struggle.
The disappearance of the Deathstalkers demonstrates the risks of reconnaissance behind fortified enemy lines.
High Executor Hadrec relies on Horde champions to support Forsaken operations when conventional troops cannot breach Arugal's cursed fortress.
